item.title: Night City comes to life with new Cyberpunk RED battle mat sets
item.description: Loke Battle Mats launches a new range of officially licensed Cyberpunk RED accessories, including lay-flat maps and dedicated chase packs for the Dark Future.

item.title: A Sparkling Debut: First impressions of Idols of the Neon Dark
item.description: Explore our first look at Idols of the Neon Dark, a K-Pop-inspired D&D 5E+ project. Check out the new Idol class and the neon-soaked streets of Lumenica.

item.title: Watch the off-the-chain trailer for psychological horror ‘Exit 8’
item.description: The trailer's just dropped for psychological horror Exit 8, based on the indie video game The Exit 8 - and it looks like it's going to be an unsettling but wild ride.

item.title: Half of Japan’s samurai were women, according to new British Museum exhibition
item.description: A groundbreaking exhibition at the British Museum reveals that half of the samurai class were women and explores their impact on modern geek culture.

item.title: Netcrawl brings cyber-dungeons to Dungeon Crawl Classics
item.description: Horseshark Games launches Netcrawl, a cyber-dungeon sidecar for Dungeon Crawl Classics featuring art by Johan Nohr.

item.title: Love is a battlefield: 100 maps for romantic RPG encounters
item.description: Agnieszka Polanowska returns to Kickstarter with The Romantic Date, a collection of 100 RPG battle maps designed for social scenes. Late pledges are now available for the funded project.

item.title: Check out the trailer for Steven Spielberg’s ‘The Dinosaurs’, set to roar onto screens next month
item.description: Netflix has released the trailer for upcoming documentary series The Dinosaurs, with executive producer Steven Spielberg - and right from the first few seconds, we can tell it's going to show us plenty of action.

item.title: Lucky for None in Space: The solo RPG that demands a d13
item.description: Explore the galaxy and try not to die in Lucky for None in Space. Beyond Cataclysm Games returns to Kickstarter with a comedy-horror solo RPG that uses a d13.

item.title: HBO greenlights Baldur’s Gate 3 series with Craig Mazin but leaves Larian Studios behind
item.description: HBO has greenlit a Baldur’s Gate 3 TV series with Craig Mazin, but original developers Larian Studios are not involved.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #347
item.description: From Baldur's Gate III screen adaptations to the massive Zine Month crowdfunding surge, get your essential weekly summary of roleplaying games news.
